bm25_lexical_and_tie_audit.pool_definition: per-DB joint table+column candidate pool for scoring; type-specific ranks are evaluated separately

automatic_error_classification.scope_note: Class labels are mechanical evidence categories. Positive lexical overlap ranked below the cutoff remains unresolved; schema-text correlations do not establish semantic mismatch or causal noise.

gold_join_coverage.multi_fk_candidate_query_overlap: query count is a candidate-availability indicator, not a count of role-labeled examples

fk_join_instance_gate.unmatched_join_reason_scope: Each unmatched parsed JOIN ON is assigned one structural reason. A table pair absent from declared FK metadata is reported as a non-FK relation candidate; SQL validity/semantic legitimacy was not evaluated by executing SQL.

decision.conclusion: diagnostic evidence only; no new ranking method success claim
